description:
Take your riding to the next level with a bike designed for the skatepark, streets, or trails. The Symbol was designed to provide precision handling so you can ride confidently and with ease.
Built to withstand the demands of freestyle BMX, the strong steel frame provides the durability and stability you need. No matter where you’re riding, this frame keeps you in control.
The Symbol Freestyle BMX bike is built for precision and control with a 20.75-inch top tube and a responsive 13.25-inch chain stay. Its 8.5-inch rise handlebars and 75° headtube angle deliver the perfect geometry for stunts, jumps, and smooth landings. Designed for freestyle riders, this bike’s compact 33/10 gearing and steel U-brake ensure top-notch control.
The Huffy Symbol is just that - a symbol. It represents a culture and lifestyle that isn’t understood by everyone. We wanted to bring that symbol to riders in a more accessible way so both newer shredders and more experienced riders alike can do what they love most. This bike is designed to be upgradable as you advance in your riding.

components.description: Controlled Braking: Steel U-brake for dependable stopping power during freestyle moves.
